data.name: Wilmar
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German elements wil 'will' and mar 'mighty' or 'waters'. This name is a reminder of the power of the natural world and the strength that lies within each of us.

in_hebrew.name: וילמר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: וילמר הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השולט על הים' או 'אלוהים הוא השולט'. הוא מורכב משני שמות עבריים: 'ויל' שמשמעותו 'אלוהים' ו'מר' שמשמעותו 'הים' או 'מרות'. השם וילמר נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא בעל משמעות רוחנית עמוקה.

in_greek.name: Ουίλμαρ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κυρίαρχος της θάλασσας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Ουίλμαρ είναι ένα όνομα που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κυρίαρχος της θάλασσας' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κυρίαρχος'. Προέρχεται από δύο ελληνικές λέξεις: 'Θεός' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και 'μάρ' που σημαίνει 'θάλασσα' ή 'εξουσία'. Το όνομα Ουίλμαρ έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί από τους πρώτους Χριστιανούς και έχει βαθιά πνευματική σημασία.

in_latin.name: Wilmar
in_latin.long_meaning: Wilmar est nomen quod significat 'Deus est dominus maris' vel 'Deus est dominus'. Componitur ex duobus nominibus Latinis: 'Deus' quod significat 'Deus' et 'mar' quod significat 'mare' vel 'potestas'. Nomen Wilmar in usu est apud Christianos et habet profundam significationem spiritualem.

in_english.name: Wilmar
in_english.meaning: God is the ruler of the sea
in_english.long_meaning: Wilmar is a Christian name that means 'God is the ruler of the sea' or 'God is the ruler'. It is derived from the Hebrew and Greek roots, combining 'wil' or 'ouil' meaning 'God' and 'mar' meaning 'sea' or 'dominion'. The name Wilmar has been used in Christian tradition and carries a deep spiritual significance, symbolizing God's power and authority over creation. Historically, the name Wilmar has been associated with strength, courage, and devotion.

Wilhelmus Adam Leonhard Marople, a Polish-German missionary priest who served in the Dutch East Indies (present-day Indonesia) in the late 18th century, was given the name Wilmar by the locals as a sign of respect and appreciation. He is known for his contributions to the early evangelization efforts in the region and his work in translating the Bible into the Malay language.
